summary: iSpecimen Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose completion of Milestone 3 in its digital transformation program with SalesStack Solutions, triggering a $700,000 payment under a previously filed software agreement. This is a routine operational update regarding a software implementation milestone, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist activity, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. The filing simply updates shareholders on progress in a contractual software deployment.
